sources.summary: NOTE: page not retrievable at fetch time (404 - MAP has retired/moved this equality-map entry); the underlying Movement Advancement Project equality-map page carried the authoritative per-state list of bans on transgender people using public bathrooms and facilities matching their gender identity, with the year each was enacted (the dossier's per-state facility-ban years come from it). For North Dakota it documents the 2025 facility ban (HB 1259 per the citations).

Erin In The Morning's July 2026 anti-trans legal-risk assessment map for transgender travellers (Erin Reed; republished 27 Aug 2026 by a regional LGBTQ outlet), built from 5 years of daily legislative tracking with a rubric for the worst bills. North Dakota is listed among 'the worst states' for legislation targeting transgender adults, and among the states that prohibit any changes to birth certificates, forcing trans people to out themselves when showing documents. Also documents that federal policies keep creating legal difficulties for transgender people nationwide.
